influences.name: Jack DeJohnette
influences.context: Asking Joe Talia to play drums like Jack DeJohnette as fast and as long as possible was the catalyst for the piece 'Knots'.

influences.name: Keiji Haino
influences.context: The earliest example I can think of this was my piece "Fever, a warm poison". Back in 2004 I did a studio session with Keiji Haino and Robbie Avenaim in Sydney... I began tinkering with one of the takes at home and ended up overdubbing my own guitars on top of Haino's original guitar track.

influences.name: Randall Dunn
influences.context: Randall for example pushes me to do stuff I might not think to do, I love his energy when we work together.

influences.name: Miles Davis
influences.context: I have the biggest admiration for jazz musicians like Miles Davis or Wes Montgomery who sometimes played just a few notes – and these worked so well because of the quality of sound.
